# Scorpion Express

> Scorpion Express Pvt Ltd is one of India's premier freight and logistics service providers — express cargo, cold chain, FTL, air freight, and warehousing across 24,000+ pincodes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Scorpion Express services and network.
- [About](/about): Company story, leadership, milestones and values.
- [Contact](/contact): HQ details and pan-India branch network with addresses.
- [Network](/network): Pan-India logistics network coverage and zones.
- [Technology](/technology): Tracking, WMS, and digital logistics platforms.
- [Careers](/careers): Current openings and how to apply.
- [Blog](/blog): Insights on logistics, supply chain and operations.
- [Events & News](/events-news): Company news and event updates.

## Services

- [Express](/services/express): Time-definite surface express delivery.
- [Air Freight](/services/air): Domestic air cargo solutions.
- [Cold Chain](/services/coldchain): Temperature-controlled logistics.
- [Warehousing (WMS)](/services/wms): Warehouse management services.
- [Cleantech](/services/cleantech): Reverse logistics for cleantech.
- [FTL](/services/ftl): Full truckload road transport.
- [MR Connect](/services/mrconnect): Medical representative connect logistics.
